title: plugin-webhooks: the sys_webhook object still says declared webhooks are "materialized into rows on boot", which ADR-0131 D2 retired
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 from the triage contract review of PR #27499 (#27448, comment 6496521580), which escalates it as its own card. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

## Observed (on `origin/main`)

`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/sys-webhook.object.ts:56`, the `sys_webhook` object's `description`, says a webhook is "Declared in code via defineStack({ webhooks }) / defineWebhook() (materialized into rows on boot) or authored directly in the Studio". Under ADR-0131 D2 a declared webhook is read from the metadata registry by the `declaredWebhooks` reader and writes no `sys_webhook` row; the dogfood proof `webhook-materialization` pins exactly that. The `managed_by` docblock (:14) and the generated translation of the description in plugin-webhooks carry the same model. PR #27499 corrected the spec's refusal text and the proof registry; this object's text is outside its surface.

## Wanted

The object's `description`, the `managed_by` text and the generated translations say what a `sys_webhook` row is today (a Studio- or API-authored subscription) and that declared webhooks are not rows. Regenerate translations with the generator. Text only.

## Dedupe words

sys_webhook description materialized into rows on boot declared webhook ADR-0131 D2 managed_by
